name: Puffer
subtitle: Puffco Proxy utilities
description: Apps for connecting to and controlling a Puffco Proxy.

apps.name: Puffer
apps.subtitle: Connect to and control your Puffco Proxy.
apps.localizedDescription: Discover, pair with, and control a Puffco Proxy over Bluetooth, including heat profiles, device settings, and live session metrics.

versions.localizedDescription: Current main build with QR bridge pairing, NFC attachment tags, widgets, and notification support. Phone-only AltStore package; the Apple Watch companion is excluded for sideload compatibility.
Apple Watch app with complication, Home and Lock Screen widget, server-driven Live Activity and notifications (including fully charged), device location tracking, and iOS 27 compatibility.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow Puffer to connect to and control your Puffco Proxy.
privacy.NFCReaderUsageDescription: Puffer writes NFC tags that switch the app to an attachment when your phone is held near it.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Expo Dev Launcher uses the local network to discover and connect to development servers running on your computer.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Puffer uses your location to show dispensaries near you, and to note where your phone was the last time it was next to your bridge so you can find it later.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Puffer to access your Face ID biometric data.
